reference_images_opened.interpretation: layout reconstruction only — hierarchy/composition: directory-first Home, large universal search above content, one compact attention block, two-column destination cards at wide widths, destination-row domain pages, provider list/detail workspace, exact search landing highlighted in form, copy as focused review flow. Synthetic names/counts/provider facts from the board were never adopted; all data comes from the shared inventory projection.

layout, hierarchy, navigation, density: editorial list-led Home (not card dashboard), narrow stable domain rail, large single-column destination rows, compact anchored search dropdown, provider roster + restrained detail sheet, nested subnavigation visibly inside Settings, quiet copy dialog.

layout, compendium architecture, manager integration: first-class All-Settings compendium (faceted, searchable, readable long-tail index over all 828 rows), domain pages combining overview + key settings + related managers, manager as integrated list/detail workspace, exact-result landing with contextual explanation, copy preview with counts/additions/replacements/unchanged/diff. Inspect-only compendium table with editable Key-settings panels per domain is this build's reading of the board.

layout, hierarchy, spacious directory, provider summary: bright spacious Home, search + attention at top, fewer/larger domain cards with strong icon/title/purpose hierarchy, domain overview made of unmistakable manager destinations, provider summary with high-value status cards + explicit quick actions, exact credential result highlighted in place, full-width copy flow with selectable categories.

LAYOUT ONLY, rethemed: borrowed persistent edge/chapter tabs for major domains, layered page depth with stable location, broad central reading canvas, domain tabs + manager-local tabs, list/detail manager composition, stepwise copy flow. All steampunk/tome skin removed — no parchment, brass, gears, medieval/fantasy copy, book ornament, skeuomorphic paper, or sepia; re-expressed in current Puppet Master theme materials, typography, spacing, icons, menus, motion. Edge tabs use short chapter labels with full-name tooltips (this pass's legibility fix).

LAYOUT ONLY, rethemed: borrowed command-index navigation, keyboard-first movement, multi-pane left-to-right drill-down, compact legible data tables, direct path/status visibility, exact setting editor beside context, transactional copy panels. No fake terminal, no green monochrome, no CRT effects, no code-only labels, no monospace body — rendered as a polished Puppet Master command workspace. Universal search lives on the Home hero; the topbar field is a command-index filter (deliberate differentiation, not a second universal search).

LAYOUT ONLY, rethemed: borrowed category tabs like a well-organized file system, layered sheets/pages preserving location, compact Home categories + recent changes, domain-level tabs + related-manager strip, provider roster with detail tabs, exact deep-link result nested in the same page stack, copy categories + source project in adjacent panes. No literal paper, folders, binder rings, staples, parchment, or office-supply decoration; translated into Puppet Master tabs/panels/surfaces/motion. The domain tabstrip is navigation tabs (packet-permitted), not a scrolling shelf.

authority boundaries for every board: six anchor screens do not limit coverage; never copy synthetic names, counts, provider facts, global scope controls, inherited settings, fantasy terminology, or visual ornament when they conflict with the packet or current repository.
